title: MedCraftRP
description: A resource pack made to compliment MedCraft
body:
MedCraftRP!!!</br>
</br>
A ResourcePack for [MedCraft](https://modrinth.com/plugin/medcraft)</br>
</br>
This is a pack made up of 4 2D models defined by CustomModelData</br>
One for each of the default items present in the plugin it is made for</br>
It is number based (Floats[int]) the int values are as follows</br>
</br>
16: Bandage</br>
17: Small Bandage</br>
18: Medkit</br>
19: Small Medkit</br>
</br>
if you need further information or require any help with using this ResourcePack</br>
I welcome you to Join our discord server and ask in the #medcraft channel</br>
